# Continual-ARC task task-16ce026f — slide object toward barrier and mark trailing edge

## Inferred rule (verified on test)
A monochrome foreground shape is placed on a uniform background, with a straight full-width/full-height color-2 barrier. Slide the foreground shape in the direction of the barrier until it is immediately adjacent to the barrier (preserve its shape and color). Then draw a full grid-spanning line of color 8 immediately beyond the shape's far edge, on the side opposite the barrier. The barrier and other background remain unchanged. In demos, the movement distance varies, and the shape translates without changing its internal pattern. If it is already adjacent to the barrier, it does not move; draw the color-8 line just outside its opposite extreme edge.

## Evidence from demos
- Demo 1: vertical color-2 barrier near right edge; color-7 object slides right one cell to become adjacent; output adds full-height color-8 line at the object's left/trailing side.
- Demo 2: horizontal barrier below object; object shifts down one cell until adjacent; adds full-width color-8 line above its new top edge.
- Demo 3: horizontal barrier above object; object shifts up until adjacent; adds full-width color-8 line below its new bottom edge.
- Demo 4: object is already immediately above horizontal barrier; it stays put and a full-width color-8 line is added just above it.
- Demo 5: vertical barrier left of object; object shifts left to become adjacent; adds full-height color-8 line just to the right of its final rightmost edge.

## Test result
The test had background 3, foreground 5 and a horizontal color-2 barrier at row 21 (0-based). The foreground shape was already directly above/touching the barrier, so it remained unchanged. Added color 8 across the entire width at row 11, immediately above its topmost row (12). This submission was confirmed CORRECT.

## Pitfalls
- Do not color the object's far-edge row; place the 8-line just outside the final translated shape.
- Do not infer the direction from the apparent majority of foreground cells; use the color-2 barrier.
- Preserve all existing cells, including holes, disconnected same-color specks, and background around the object; only translate foreground toward the barrier and add the full-span 8-line.
- Use zero-based grid indexing when generating the line coordinate.
